local go = self.gameObject

function GetKey()
    return key
end

function OnNetDestroy()
    if go == nil then
        return
    end
    local record = Registry.get(go) or Registry.bind(go, Registry.Mode.Network)

    end

        Registry.release(go)
        go = nil
    end
end

local UnityDebug = CS.UnityEngine.Debug

local Logger = {}
local LoggerInstance = {}
LoggerInstance.__index = LoggerInstance

local function normalizeTag(tag)
    if tag == nil or tag == "" then
        return "worldplay"
    end
    return tostring(tag)
end

local function formatMessage(tag, ...)
    local parts = { "[" .. tag .. "]" }
    for index = 1, select("#", ...) do
        local value = select(index, ...)
        parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(value)
    end
    return table.concat(parts, " ")
end

function LoggerInstance:info(...)
    UnityDebug.Log(formatMessage(self.tag, ...))
end

function LoggerInstance:warn(...)
    UnityDebug.LogWarning(formatMessage(self.tag, ...))
end

function LoggerInstance:error(...)
    UnityDebug.LogError(formatMessage(self.tag, ...))
end

function LoggerInstance:warnOnce(key, ...)
    if key == nil then
        self:warn(...)
        return true
    end

    local normalizedKey = tostring(key)
    if self.warnedKeys[normalizedKey] == true then
        return false
    end
    self.warnedKeys[normalizedKey] = true
    self:warn(...)
    return true
end

function Logger.create(tag)
    return setmetatable({
        tag = normalizeTag(tag),
        warnedKeys = {},
    }, LoggerInstance)
end

return Logger

local NodeLookup = {}

NodeLookup.Reason = {
    InvalidRoot = "node-lookup-invalid-root",
    InvalidPath = "node-lookup-invalid-path",
    NotFound = "node-lookup-not-found",
}

local function resolveTransform(value)
    if value == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return value.transform
    end)
    if ok and transform ~= nil then
        return transform
    end

    ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return value.gameObject.transform
    end)
    if ok and transform ~= nil then
        return transform
    end

    local childCount
    ok, childCount = pcall(function()
        return value.childCount
    end)
    if ok and childCount ~= nil then
        return value
    end
    return nil
end

local function resolveGameObject(transform)
    if transform == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, gameObject = pcall(function()
        return transform.gameObject
    end)
    if ok then
        return gameObject
    end
    return nil
end

local function isValidPathSegment(segment)
    if type(segment) ~= "string" or segment == "" or segment == "." or segment == ".." then
        return false
    end
    if segment:find("/", 1, true) ~= nil or segment:find("\\", 1, true) ~= nil then
        return false
    end
    for index = 1, #segment do
        local byte = segment:byte(index)
        if byte <= 31 or byte == 127 then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

local function getTransformName(transform)
    if transform == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, name = pcall(function()
        return transform.name
    end)
    if ok and isValidPathSegment(name) then
        return name
    end
    return nil
end

local function isValidNodePath(path)
    if type(path) ~= "string" then
        return false
    end
    if path == "" then
        return true
    end
    if path:sub(1, 1) == "/" or path:sub(-1) == "/" then
        return false
    end
    if path:find("//", 1, true) ~= nil then
        return false
    end

    for segment in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do
        if not isValidPathSegment(segment) then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

-- Accept one leading slash. When an exact lookup misses, retry once without
-- the GLB root segment so inspected full paths survive Runtime root renames.
local function stripOneLeadingSlash(path)
    if type(path) ~= "string" then
        return path
    end
    if path:sub(1, 1) == "/" then
        return path:sub(2)
    end
    return path
end

local function stripGlbRootSegment(path)
    local separatorIndex = path:find("/", 1, true)
    if separatorIndex == nil then
        return nil
    end
    return path:sub(separatorIndex + 1)
end

local function normalizeNodePath(nodePath)
    local normalizedPath = stripOneLeadingSlash(nodePath)
    if not isValidNodePath(normalizedPath) then
        return nil
    end
    return normalizedPath
end

local function findIndexedValue(valueByPath, normalizedPath, initialRootName)
    local value = valueByPath[normalizedPath]
    if value ~= nil then
        return value
    end

    -- Exact child paths win over root aliases, including after a root rename.
    local root = valueByPath[""]
    if normalizedPath == initialRootName or normalizedPath == getTransformName(resolveTransform(root)) then
        return root
    end

    local rootRelativePath = stripGlbRootSegment(normalizedPath)
    if rootRelativePath == nil then
        return nil
    end
    return valueByPath[rootRelativePath]
end

local function tryFindTransform(rootTransform, path)
    local ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return rootTransform:Find(path)
    end)
    if not ok then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end
    return transform
end

function NodeLookup.createIndex(root)
    local rootTransform = resolveTransform(root)
    local rootGameObject = resolveGameObject(rootTransform)
    if rootTransform == nil or rootGameObject == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end

    local index = {
        transformByPath = { [""] = rootTransform },
        gameObjectByPath = { [""] = rootGameObject },
        initialRootName = getTransformName(rootTransform),
    }
    local pending = { { path = "", transform = rootTransform } }

    while #pending > 0 do
        local current = table.remove(pending)
        local ok, childCount = pcall(function()
            return current.transform.childCount
        end)
        if not ok or type(childCount) ~= "number" then
            return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
        end

        for childIndex = 0, childCount - 1 do
            local childOk, child = pcall(function()
                return current.transform:GetChild(childIndex)
            end)
            if not childOk or child == nil then
                return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
            end

            local nameOk, childName = pcall(function()
                return child.name
            end)
            if not nameOk then
                return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
            end

            if isValidPathSegment(childName) then
                local childPath = current.path == "" and childName or current.path .. "/" .. childName
                if index.transformByPath[childPath] == nil then
                    local childGameObject = resolveGameObject(child)
                    if childGameObject == nil then
                        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
                    end
                    index.transformByPath[childPath] = child
                    index.gameObjectByPath[childPath] = childGameObject
                    pending[#pending + 1] = { path = childPath, transform = child }
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return index
end

function NodeLookup.getTransformByPath(root, nodePath)
    local rootTransform = resolveTransform(root)
    if rootTransform == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end

    local normalizedPath = normalizeNodePath(nodePath)
    if normalizedPath == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidPath
    end
    if normalizedPath == "" then
        return rootTransform
    end

    local transform, reason = tryFindTransform(rootTransform, normalizedPath)
    if reason ~= nil then
        return nil, reason
    end
    if transform ~= nil then
        return transform
    end

    if normalizedPath == getTransformName(rootTransform) then
        return rootTransform
    end

    local rootRelativePath = stripGlbRootSegment(normalizedPath)
    if rootRelativePath == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.NotFound
    end

    transform, reason = tryFindTransform(rootTransform, rootRelativePath)
    if reason ~= nil then
        return nil, reason
    end
    if transform == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.NotFound
    end
    return transform
end

function NodeLookup.getIndexedTransformByPath(index, nodePath)
    if type(index) ~= "table" or type(index.transformByPath) ~= "table" then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end

    local normalizedPath = normalizeNodePath(nodePath)
    if normalizedPath == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidPath
    end

    local transform = findIndexedValue(index.transformByPath, normalizedPath, index.initialRootName)
    if transform == nil or resolveGameObject(transform) == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.NotFound
    end
    return transform
end

function NodeLookup.getGameObjectByPath(root, nodePath)
    local transform, reason = NodeLookup.getTransformByPath(root, nodePath)
    if transform == nil then
        return nil, reason
    end
    local ok, gameObject = pcall(function()
        return transform.gameObject
    end)
    if not ok or gameObject == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end
    return gameObject
end

function NodeLookup.getIndexedGameObjectByPath(index, nodePath)
    if type(index) ~= "table" or type(index.gameObjectByPath) ~= "table" then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end

    local normalizedPath = normalizeNodePath(nodePath)
    if normalizedPath == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidPath
    end

    local gameObject = findIndexedValue(index.gameObjectByPath, normalizedPath, index.initialRootName)
    if gameObject == nil or resolveTransform(gameObject) == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.NotFound
    end
    return gameObject
end

-- Compatibility aliases for existing scripts.
NodeLookup.findTransform = NodeLookup.getTransformByPath
NodeLookup.findGameObject = NodeLookup.getGameObjectByPath
NodeLookup.findIndexedTransform = NodeLookup.getIndexedTransformByPath
NodeLookup.findIndexedGameObject = NodeLookup.getIndexedGameObjectByPath

return NodeLookup

local NodeLookup = require("official.core.node_lookup")

local RuntimeScope = {}

RuntimeScope.Reason = {
    InvalidRoot = "runtime-resource-scope-invalid-root",
    Unavailable = "runtime-resource-scope-unavailable",
    InvalidScriptId = "runtime-script-invalid-id",
    ScriptNotReady = "runtime-script-not-ready",
    ScriptQueryFailed = "runtime-script-query-failed",
    RuntimeHostUnbound = "runtime-host-unbound",
    RuntimeHostScriptNotReady = "runtime-host-script-not-ready",
    RuntimeHostScriptQueryFailed = "runtime-host-script-query-failed",
}

local Scope = {}
Scope.__index = Scope

local RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_NAME = "runtime-builtin/runtime-host-root-bootstrap.lua"
local RUNTIME_RESOURCE_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_NAME = "runtime-builtin/runtime-resource-root-bootstrap.lua"

local scopeByGameObject = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local scopeByResourceRoot = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function resolveGameObject(value)
    if value == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, gameObject = pcall(function()
        return value.gameObject
    end)
    if ok and gameObject ~= nil then
        return gameObject
    end
    return value
end

local function resolveTransform(value)
    local gameObject = resolveGameObject(value)
    if gameObject == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return gameObject.transform
    end)
    if ok and transform ~= nil then
        return transform
    end

    ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return value.transform
    end)
    if ok then
        return transform
    end
    return nil
end

local function bindGameObject(scope, gameObject)
    if gameObject == nil then
        return
    end

    local previousScope = scopeByGameObject[gameObject]
    if previousScope ~= nil and previousScope ~= scope then
        previousScope.members[gameObject] = nil
    end
    scopeByGameObject[gameObject] = scope
    scope.members[gameObject] = true
end

local function normalizeScriptId(scriptId)
    if type(scriptId) ~= "string" or scriptId == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local runtimeScriptId = string.gsub(scriptId, "/", "_")
    return runtimeScriptId
end

local function hasBuiltinMarker(gameObject, referenceName)
    local runtimeScriptId = normalizeScriptId(referenceName)
    if runtimeScriptId == nil then
        return false
    end

    local ok, component = pcall(function()
        return gameObject:GetDouyinScript(runtimeScriptId)
    end)
    return ok and component ~= nil
end

local function isNestedScopeRoot(scope, gameObject)
    if gameObject == scope.resourceRoot then
        return false
    end
    return hasBuiltinMarker(gameObject, RUNTIME_RESOURCE_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_NAME)
        or hasBuiltinMarker(gameObject, RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_NAME)
end

local function collectSubtreeGameObjects(scope, root, stopAtScopeBoundaries)
    local rootTransform = resolveTransform(root)
    if rootTransform == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local gameObjects = {}
    local pending = { rootTransform }
    while #pending > 0 do
        local transform = table.remove(pending)
        local gameObject = resolveGameObject(transform)
        if gameObject == nil then
            return nil
        end

        if not stopAtScopeBoundaries or not isNestedScopeRoot(scope, gameObject) then
            gameObjects[#gameObjects + 1] = gameObject

            local ok, childCount = pcall(function()
                return transform.childCount
            end)
            if not ok or type(childCount) ~= "number" then
                return nil
            end
            for index = 0, childCount - 1 do
                local childOk, child = pcall(function()
                    return transform:GetChild(index)
                end)
                if not childOk or child == nil then
                    return nil
                end
                pending[#pending + 1] = child
            end
        end
    end
    return gameObjects
end

local function bindSubtree(scope, root, stopAtScopeBoundaries)
    local gameObjects = collectSubtreeGameObjects(scope, root, stopAtScopeBoundaries)
    if gameObjects == nil then
        return false
    end
    for _, gameObject in ipairs(gameObjects) do
        bindGameObject(scope, gameObject)
    end
    return true
end

local function findNearestMarker(value, referenceName)
    local transform = resolveTransform(value)
    while transform ~= nil do
        local gameObject = transform.gameObject
        if hasBuiltinMarker(gameObject, referenceName) then
            return gameObject
        end
        transform = transform.parent
    end
    return nil
end

local function findNearestScopeRoot(value)
    local transform = resolveTransform(value)
    while transform ~= nil do
        local gameObject = transform.gameObject
        if hasBuiltinMarker(gameObject, RUNTIME_RESOURCE_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_NAME) then
            return gameObject, false
        end
        if hasBuiltinMarker(gameObject, RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_NAME) then
            return gameObject, true
        end
        transform = transform.parent
    end
    return nil, false
end

local function queryScript(root, scriptId, queryFailedReason, notReadyReason)
    if root == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end

    local runtimeScriptId = normalizeScriptId(scriptId)
    if runtimeScriptId == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidScriptId
    end

    local ok, script = pcall(function()
        local component = root:GetDouyinScript(runtimeScriptId)
        return component ~= nil and component.script or nil
    end)
    if not ok then
        return nil, queryFailedReason
    end
    if script == nil then
        return nil, notReadyReason
    end
    return script
end

local function createDirectScope(resourceRoot, runtimeHostRoot, isRuntimeHostRoot)
    local existingScope = scopeByResourceRoot[resourceRoot]
    if existingScope ~= nil
        and existingScope.runtimeHostRoot == runtimeHostRoot
        and existingScope.isRuntimeHostRoot == isRuntimeHostRoot then
        bindGameObject(existingScope, resourceRoot)
        return existingScope
    end

    local nodeIndex = NodeLookup.createIndex(resourceRoot)
    if nodeIndex == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end

    RuntimeScope.unregister(resourceRoot)
    local scope = setmetatable({
        isRuntimeHostRoot = isRuntimeHostRoot,
        resourceRoot = resourceRoot,
        runtimeHostRoot = runtimeHostRoot,
        nodeIndex = nodeIndex,
        members = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    }, Scope)
    if isRuntimeHostRoot then
        bindGameObject(scope, resourceRoot)
    elseif not bindSubtree(scope, resourceRoot, true) then
        scope.nodeIndex = nil
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end
    scopeByResourceRoot[resourceRoot] = scope
    return scope
end

function Scope:GetResourceRoot()
    return self.resourceRoot
end

function Scope:GetRuntimeHostRoot()
    if self.runtimeHostRoot ~= nil then
        return self.runtimeHostRoot
    end
    return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.RuntimeHostUnbound
end

function Scope:GetScript(scriptId)
    if self.nodeIndex == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end
    local runtimeScriptId = normalizeScriptId(scriptId)
    if runtimeScriptId == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidScriptId
    end

    -- Membership survives reparenting and excludes nested resource scopes.
    -- Each script ID has at most one binding within the scope.
    local matchedObject = nil
    local queryFailed = false
    for gameObject in pairs(self.members) do
        if scopeByGameObject[gameObject] == self then
            local ok, component = pcall(function()
                return gameObject:GetDouyinScript(runtimeScriptId)
            end)
            if not ok then
                queryFailed = true
            elseif component ~= nil then
                matchedObject = gameObject
            end
        end
    end
    if queryFailed then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.ScriptQueryFailed
    end

    -- Do not cache absence or script tables: a later call may observe readiness.
    if matchedObject == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.ScriptNotReady
    end
    return queryScript(matchedObject, scriptId, RuntimeScope.Reason.ScriptQueryFailed, RuntimeScope.Reason.ScriptNotReady)
end

function Scope:GetTransformByPath(nodePath)
    return NodeLookup.getIndexedTransformByPath(self.nodeIndex, nodePath)
end

function Scope:GetGameObjectByPath(nodePath)
    return NodeLookup.getIndexedGameObjectByPath(self.nodeIndex, nodePath)
end

-- Compatibility aliases for existing scripts.
Scope.FindTransform = Scope.GetTransformByPath
Scope.FindGameObject = Scope.GetGameObjectByPath

function Scope:GetRuntimeHostScript(scriptId)
    local runtimeHostRoot, reason = self:GetRuntimeHostRoot()
    if runtimeHostRoot == nil then
        return nil, reason
    end

    return queryScript(
        runtimeHostRoot,
        scriptId or "runtime-host.lua",
        RuntimeScope.Reason.RuntimeHostScriptQueryFailed,
        RuntimeScope.Reason.RuntimeHostScriptNotReady
    )
end

function RuntimeScope.registerHostRoot(resourceRoot)
    local rootGameObject = resolveGameObject(resourceRoot)
    if rootGameObject == nil or resolveTransform(rootGameObject) == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end
    return createDirectScope(rootGameObject, rootGameObject, true)
end

function RuntimeScope.registerResourceRoot(resourceRoot)
    local rootGameObject = resolveGameObject(resourceRoot)
    local rootTransform = resolveTransform(rootGameObject)
    if rootGameObject == nil or rootTransform == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end

    local runtimeHostRoot = findNearestMarker(rootTransform.parent, RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_NAME)
    return createDirectScope(rootGameObject, runtimeHostRoot, false)
end

function RuntimeScope.unregister(resourceRoot, expectedScope)
    local rootGameObject = resolveGameObject(resourceRoot)
    local scope = rootGameObject ~= nil and scopeByResourceRoot[rootGameObject] or nil
    if scope == nil or (expectedScope ~= nil and scope ~= expectedScope) then
        return false
    end

    for gameObject in pairs(scope.members) do
        if scopeByGameObject[gameObject] == scope then
            scopeByGameObject[gameObject] = nil
        end
    end
    scope.nodeIndex = nil
    scope.members = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    scopeByResourceRoot[rootGameObject] = nil
    return true
end

function RuntimeScope.discover(value)
    local gameObject = resolveGameObject(value)
    if gameObject == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.Unavailable
    end

    local resourceRoot, isRuntimeHostRoot = findNearestScopeRoot(gameObject)
    local scope = nil
    if isRuntimeHostRoot then
        scope = RuntimeScope.registerHostRoot(resourceRoot)
    elseif resourceRoot ~= nil then
        scope = RuntimeScope.registerResourceRoot(resourceRoot)
    end

    if scope == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.Unavailable
    end
    bindGameObject(scope, gameObject)
    return scope
end

function RuntimeScope.from(value)
    local gameObject = resolveGameObject(value)
    local scope = gameObject ~= nil and scopeByGameObject[gameObject] or nil
    if scope ~= nil then
        return scope
    end
    return RuntimeScope.discover(gameObject)
end

function RuntimeScope.resolveResourceRoot(value)
    local scope, reason = RuntimeScope.from(value)
    if scope == nil then
        return nil, reason
    end
    return scope:GetResourceRoot()
end

function RuntimeScope.bindGameObject(scope, value)
    local gameObject = resolveGameObject(value)
    if scope == nil or scope.resourceRoot == nil or gameObject == nil then
        return false, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end
    bindGameObject(scope, gameObject)
    return true
end

function RuntimeScope.bindSubtree(scope, value)
    if scope == nil or scope.resourceRoot == nil or not bindSubtree(scope, value) then
        return false, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end
    return true
end

return RuntimeScope

local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Registry = require("official.core.spawn_registry")
local UnityObject = CS.UnityEngine.Object
local Spawn = {}

Spawn.Lifetime = { Room = "Room", Actor = "Actor" }
local MARKER = "runtime-builtin___NetSpawnTarget__.lua"
local allowedOptions = { networked = true, lifetime = true, actor = true, position = true, rotation = true }

local function validateOptions(options, onSpawn)
    if type(options) ~= "table" or type(options.networked) ~= "boolean" then
        error("spawn_networked_boolean_required", 3)
    end
    for name in pairs(options) do
        if not allowedOptions[name] then
            error("spawn_unknown_option: " .. tostring(name), 3)
        end
    end
    if onSpawn ~= nil and type(onSpawn) ~= "function" then
        error("spawn_invalid_callback", 3)
    end
    if options.rotation ~= nil and options.position == nil then
        error("spawn_rotation_requires_position", 3)
    end
    if not options.networked then
        if options.lifetime ~= nil or options.actor ~= nil then
            error("spawn_local_network_options", 3)
        end
    elseif options.lifetime == Spawn.Lifetime.Actor then
        if options.actor == nil then
            error("spawn_actor_required", 3)
        end
    elseif options.lifetime ~= Spawn.Lifetime.Room then
        error("spawn_network_lifetime_required", 3)
    elseif options.actor ~= nil then
        error("spawn_room_actor_not_allowed", 3)
    end
end

local function resolveSource(context, path)
    if type(path) ~= "string" then
        error("spawn_source_path_required", 3)
    end
    local scope, reason = RuntimeScope.from(context)
    if scope == nil then
        error(reason or "spawn_resource_unavailable", 3)
    end
    local source, lookupReason = scope:GetGameObjectByPath(path)
    if source == nil then
        error(lookupReason or "spawn_source_missing", 3)
    end
    return source, scope
end

local function prepareNetwork(source, options)
    if DouyinNetService == nil or not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
        error("spawn_network_not_ready", 3)
    end
    local marker = source:GetDouyinScript(MARKER)
    if marker == nil or marker.script == nil then
        error("spawn_source_not_registered", 3)
    end
    local key = marker.script.GetKey()
    if type(key) ~= "string" or key == "" then
        error("spawn_source_not_registered", 3)
    end
    if options.lifetime == Spawn.Lifetime.Actor then
        local actor = options.actor
        if actor.gameObject == nil or not Registry.isAlive(actor.gameObject)
            or type(actor.NetSpawn) ~= "function" then
            error("spawn_invalid_actor", 3)
        end
    elseif DouyinObjectService == nil or type(DouyinObjectService.NetSpawn) ~= "function" then
        error("spawn_network_service_unavailable", 3)
    end
    return key
end

local function networkSpawn(key, options, callback)
    -- Use the documented overloads; never retry with another signature.
    local actor = options.actor
    if options.lifetime == Spawn.Lifetime.Actor then
        if options.rotation ~= nil then
            return actor:NetSpawn(key, options.position, options.rotation, callback)
        elseif options.position ~= nil then
            return actor:NetSpawn(key, options.position, callback)
        end
        return actor:NetSpawn(key, callback)
    end
    if options.rotation ~= nil then
        return DouyinObjectService.NetSpawn(key, options.position, options.rotation, callback)
    elseif options.position ~= nil then
        return DouyinObjectService.NetSpawn(key, options.position, callback)
    end
    return DouyinObjectService.NetSpawn(key, callback)
end

--- Copy a resource-local source. Only the native GameObject is returned.
function Spawn.spawn(context, sourcePath, options, onSpawn)
    validateOptions(options, onSpawn)
    local source, scope = resolveSource(context, sourcePath)
    if not Registry.isAlive(source) then
        error("spawn_source_destroyed", 2)
    end
    local function register(obj, mode)
        if not Registry.isAlive(obj) then
            return false
        end
        local record = Registry.bind(obj, mode)
        -- 销毁确认后的迟到回调不能重新绑定 Scope 或初始化玩法。
        if record.destroying then return false end
        -- 资源根副本建立独立 Scope；普通子树沿用来源 Scope。
        if RuntimeScope.from(obj) == nil then
            RuntimeScope.bindSubtree(scope, obj)
        end
        return true
    end
    if not options.networked then
        local obj
        if options.position ~= nil then
            obj = UnityObject.Instantiate(source, options.position, options.rotation or source.transform.rotation)
        else
            obj = UnityObject.Instantiate(source)
        end
        register(obj, Registry.Mode.Local)
        if Registry.isAlive(obj) and onSpawn ~= nil then
            onSpawn(obj)
        end
        return obj
    end

    local key = prepareNetwork(source, options)
    local callbackDelivered = false
    local callbackObject
    local returnedObject
    local returned = false
    local function initialize(obj)
        if callbackDelivered then
            if obj ~= callbackObject then
                error("spawn_callback_object_mismatch")
            end
            return
        end
        if returned and obj ~= returnedObject then
            error("spawn_callback_object_mismatch")
        end
        callbackDelivered = true
        callbackObject = obj
        if obj ~= nil and not register(obj, Registry.Mode.Network) then return end
        if onSpawn ~= nil then
            onSpawn(obj)
        end
    end
    -- Deliberately discard the SDK's second return value (network instance ID).
    local obj = networkSpawn(key, options, initialize)
    returnedObject = obj
    returned = true
    if callbackDelivered and obj ~= callbackObject then
        error("spawn_callback_object_mismatch", 2)
    end
    register(obj, Registry.Mode.Network)
    return obj
end

--- Request destruction using the tracked mode; this is not a completion signal.
function Spawn.destroy(go)
    if go == nil then
        return
    end
    if not Registry.isAlive(go) then
        Registry.release(go)
        return
    end
    local record = Registry.get(go)
    if record ~= nil and record.destroying then
        return
    end
    if record ~= nil and record.mode == Registry.Mode.Local then
        UnityObject.Destroy(go)
        record.destroying = true
        return
    end
    local marker = go:GetDouyinScript(MARKER)
    if marker == nil then
        error("spawn_unknown_instance", 2)
    end
    if DouyinNetService == nil or not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
        error("spawn_network_not_ready", 2)
    end
    if not marker:IsSpawned() then
        error("spawn_instance_not_ready", 2)
    end
    if not marker:HasOwnership() then
        error("spawn_ownership_required", 2)
    end
    -- The platform decides whether to accept the request. A void return must
    -- not prevent a later retry if the object is still alive.
    Registry.bind(go, Registry.Mode.Network)
    DouyinObjectService.NetDestroy(go, false)
end

return Spawn

local Logger = require("official.core.logger")

local logger = Logger.create("official-effect")

local Effect = {}

Effect.Reason = {
    Unavailable = "effect-system-unavailable",
    InvalidContext = "effect-invalid-context",
    InvalidKey = "effect-invalid-key",
    NotFound = "effect-not-found",
    AmbiguousTemplate = "effect-ambiguous-template",
    NotReady = "effect-not-ready",
    -- spawn 已能播放循环特效、不再返回；保留供旧脚本比较。
    Looping = "effect-spawn-rejected-looping",
    SpawnFailed = "effect-spawn-failed",
    Inactive = "effect-inactive-hierarchy",
}

-- 占位表是 xLua 对缺失 C# 类型返回的伪对象（带 .fqn），不能当作真实类型或实例。
local function isRealCsValue(value)
    if value == nil then
        return false
    end
    if type(value) ~= "table" then
        return true
    end
    local ok, fqn = pcall(rawget, value, ".fqn")
    return ok and fqn == nil
end

local function resolveGameObject(value)
    if value == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, gameObject = pcall(function()
        return value.gameObject
    end)
    if ok and gameObject ~= nil then
        return gameObject
    end

    ok, gameObject = pcall(function()
        return value.transform ~= nil and value or nil
    end)
    if ok then
        return gameObject
    end
    return nil
end

local function resolveTransform(value)
    local gameObject = resolveGameObject(value)
    if gameObject == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return gameObject.transform
    end)
    if ok then
        return transform
    end
    return nil
end

local function destroyObject(gameObject, delay)
    if gameObject == nil then
        return
    end
    pcall(function()
        if delay == nil then
            CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(gameObject)
        else
            CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(gameObject, delay)
        end
    end)
end

-- 引用可能指向预制体外层；只接受其子树中的唯一效果根，不拆分根内的粒子。
local function findMarkedRoot(gameObject, isRoot)
    local pending = { gameObject }
    local found = nil
    while #pending > 0 do
        local candidate = table.remove(pending)
        if isRoot(candidate) then
            if found ~= nil then
                return nil, Effect.Reason.AmbiguousTemplate
            end
            found = candidate
        else
            local transform = candidate.transform
            for i = 0, transform.childCount - 1 do
                pending[#pending + 1] = transform:GetChild(i).gameObject
            end
        end
    end
    return found, found == nil and Effect.Reason.NotFound or nil
end

-- 编辑器宿主：转调 C# EffectSystem。
local Studio = {}

function Studio.resolve(gameObject, key)
    return Studio.system:ResolvePoolTemplate(gameObject, key)
end

function Studio.resolveReferenced(gameObject)
    return findMarkedRoot(gameObject, function(candidate)
        return Studio.system:GetComponent(candidate) ~= nil
    end)
end

function Studio.isReady(template)
    return Studio.system:IsPoolTemplateReady(template)
end

function Studio.isLooping(template)
    return Studio.system:IsPoolTemplateLooping(template)
end

-- 副本激活时由 MonoChain.Awake 按复制来源接管特效资源，这里不必处理。
function Studio.adopt()
end

function Studio.play(template)
    return Studio.system:PlayTemplate(template)
end

function Studio.stop(template, immediate)
    Studio.system:StopTemplate(template, immediate)
end

function Studio.spawn(gameObject, template, key, position, options)
    if type(key) ~= "string" then
        -- 公开池接口按名称解析；确认仍是引用对象，避免同名模板导致误播。
        gameObject = template
        key = template.name
        local resolved, exact = pcall(function()
            local candidate = Studio.system:ResolvePoolTemplate(gameObject, key)
            return candidate ~= nil and candidate:Equals(template)
        end)
        if not resolved or not exact then
            return nil, Effect.Reason.NotFound
        end
    end
    if position == nil then
        return Studio.system:Spawn(gameObject, key)
    end
    local rotation = options ~= nil and options.rotation or template.transform.rotation
    local scale = options ~= nil and options.scale or 1
    local parent = options ~= nil and resolveTransform(options.parent) or nil
    return Studio.system:SpawnAt(gameObject, key, position, rotation, scale, parent)
end

-- 预览端与发布态没有 EffectSystem：特效是原生 ParticleSystem（发布态已烘焙），这里直接用 Lua 驱动。
-- 官方库没有逐帧驱动：spawn 副本不复用，spawn 与 Stop 按宿主定时器检查粒子是否结束；副本另有引擎销毁兜底。
local Native = {
    CopyCapacity = 8,
    FadeGraceSeconds = 0.1,
    FadePollSeconds = 0.25,
    -- 与 studio 一致：发射时长 ≤30 秒是生成侧硬预算，超时只可能是配置异常，强制收尾。
    FadeTimeoutSeconds = 30,
    PoolRootName = "__EffectPool",
    -- 发布转换（WorldSdkEffectPublisher）移除 EffectRuntimeRoot 时在效果根下留的空子节点，两边按此名字对齐。
    RootMarkerName = "__EffectRoot",
    copies = {},
    fades = {},
    -- 预览端效果根是热更类型，发布态没有该程序集（取到占位表）。按 System.Type 取组件：
    -- 按名字取要带命名空间，否则直接报错，且每次调用都会打 deprecated 警告。
    runtimeRootType = nil,
}
do
    local ok, value = pcall(function()
        return CS.Hamlet.AIEffects.EffectRuntimeRoot
    end)
    if ok and isRealCsValue(value) and typeof ~= nil then
        local typed, systemType = pcall(typeof, value)
        if typed then
            Native.runtimeRootType = systemType
        end
    end
end

-- 被销毁的 UnityEngine.Object 在 xLua 里不等于 nil，只能靠 Equals(nil)；访问出错同样视为已销毁。
function Native.isDestroyed(object)
    if object == nil then
        return true
    end
    local ok, destroyed = pcall(function()
        return object:Equals(nil)
    end)
    return not ok or destroyed == true
end

function Native.particleType()
    local particleSystem = CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem
    if typeof ~= nil then
        return typeof(particleSystem)
    end
    return particleSystem
end

-- 子发射器目标只由父系统触发，不能单独 Play。
function Native.classify(all)
    local targets = {}
    for _, system in ipairs(all) do
        pcall(function()
            local module = system.subEmitters
            if not module.enabled then
                return
            end
            for subIndex = 0, module.subEmittersCount - 1 do
                local target = module:GetSubEmitterSystem(subIndex)
                if target ~= nil then
                    targets[target:GetInstanceID()] = true
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    local playable = {}
    for _, system in ipairs(all) do
        if not targets[system:GetInstanceID()] then
            playable[#playable + 1] = system
        end
    end
    return { all = all, playable = playable }
end

-- 整棵子树（含 inactive 与自身）的粒子：Stop 与收尾用这个范围，同 C# StopTemplate。
function Native.collect(gameObject)
    local array = gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(Native.particleType(), true)
    local all = {}
    for index = 0, array.Length - 1 do
        if array[index] ~= nil then
            all[#all + 1] = array[index]
        end
    end
    return Native.classify(all)
end

-- 预览端效果根带 EffectRuntimeRoot；发布态已被移除，类型也不存在，返回 nil。
function Native.runtimeRoot(gameObject)
    local rootType = Native.runtimeRootType
    if rootType == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, root = pcall(function()
        return gameObject:GetComponent(rootType)
    end)
    if ok and isRealCsValue(root) and not Native.isDestroyed(root) then
        return root
    end
    return nil
end

-- 预览端认 EffectRuntimeRoot，发布态认发布转换留下的标记子节点；层级结构本身分不清效果根与外层容器。
function Native.isEffectRoot(gameObject)
    if Native.runtimeRoot(gameObject) ~= nil then
        return true
    end
    local ok, marker = pcall(function()
        return gameObject.transform:Find(Native.RootMarkerName)
    end)
    return ok and marker ~= nil
end

-- 效果根自己拥有的粒子：Play / IsLooping 只作用于这些，同 C# EffectRuntimeRoot，嵌套的独立效果根各管各的。
-- 预览端直接取 EffectRuntimeRoot.Systems；发布态没有该组件，沿子树收集、遇到嵌套效果根即停。
function Native.owned(template)
    local root = Native.runtimeRoot(template)
    if root ~= nil then
        local ok, array = pcall(function()
            return root.Systems
        end)
        if ok and array ~= nil then
            local all = {}
            for index = 0, array.Length - 1 do
                if array[index] ~= nil then
                    all[#all + 1] = array[index]
                end
            end
            return Native.classify(all)
        end
    end
    local all, pending = {}, { template.transform }
    while #pending > 0 do
        local node = table.remove(pending)
        local system = node.gameObject:GetComponent(Native.particleType())
        if system ~= nil then
            all[#all + 1] = system
        end
        for index = node.childCount - 1, 0, -1 do
            local child = node:GetChild(index)
            if not Native.isEffectRoot(child.gameObject) then
                pending[#pending + 1] = child
            end
        end
    end
    return Native.classify(all)
end

-- 预览端副本按复制来源接管效果资源（studio 由 MonoChain.Awake 完成），否则 IsReady 恒为 false、不持有模板资源。
-- Instantiate 保留层级顺序，按位置逐节点配对，与 C# AdoptHierarchy 同规则；发布态没有效果根，什么也不做。
function Native.adopt(template, copy)
    local pending = { { template.transform, copy.transform } }
    while #pending > 0 do
        local pair = table.remove(pending)
        local source, target = pair[1], pair[2]
        local sourceRoot = Native.runtimeRoot(source.gameObject)
        if sourceRoot ~= nil then
            local targetRoot = Native.runtimeRoot(target.gameObject)
            if targetRoot == nil then
                error("effect copy lost its runtime root: " .. tostring(target.gameObject.name))
            end
            targetRoot:AdoptClone(sourceRoot)
        end
        for index = 0, source.childCount - 1 do
            pending[#pending + 1] = { source:GetChild(index), target:GetChild(index) }
        end
    end
end

-- 与 C# ResolvePoolTemplate 同规则：沿父链逐层找同名直接子节点，只认效果根，同名的容器或发射节点跳过。
function Native.resolve(gameObject, key)
    local normalized = key:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    if normalized == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local node = gameObject.transform
    while node ~= nil do
        for index = 0, node.childCount - 1 do
            local child = node:GetChild(index).gameObject
            if child.name == normalized and Native.isEffectRoot(child) then
                return child
            end
        end
        node = node.parent
    end
    return nil
end

-- 与 studio 同规则：引用自身或子树里的唯一效果根，多个返回歧义；没有身份信息就是找不到，不按结构猜。
function Native.resolveReferenced(gameObject)
    return findMarkedRoot(gameObject, Native.isEffectRoot)
end

-- 预览端效果资源异步加载，未就绪前粒子还没还原；发布态粒子已落盘，始终就绪。
function Native.isReady(template)
    local root = Native.runtimeRoot(template)
    if root == nil then
        return true
    end
    local ok, ready = pcall(function()
        return root.IsReady
    end)
    return not ok or ready == true
end

function Native.isLooping(template)
    for _, system in ipairs(Native.owned(template).all) do
        if system.main.loop == true then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- 先整体 Stop+Clear 再逐个 Play，对应 C# EffectRuntimeRoot.Play；只碰根自己的粒子，不重置嵌套的效果根。
function Native.restart(gameObject, info)
    local clear = CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystemStopBehavior.StopEmittingAndClear
    for _, system in ipairs(info.all) do
        system:Stop(false, clear)
    end
    for _, system in ipairs(info.playable) do
        if system.gameObject.activeInHierarchy then
            system:Play(false)
        end
    end
end

-- 预览端与发布版客户端都在 Lua 全局提供 setTimeout / clearTimeout，按 Time.time 在主循环派发。
-- 宿主没有时返回 nil，收尾退回 sweep，在下次调用本模块时补做。
function Native.schedule(callback, seconds)
    local set = setTimeout
    if set == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, id = pcall(set, callback, math.max(1, math.ceil(seconds * 1000)))
    return ok and id or nil
end

function Native.unschedule(id)
    if id ~= nil and clearTimeout ~= nil then
        pcall(clearTimeout, id)
    end
end

function Native.removeFade(fade)
    Native.unschedule(fade.timer)
    fade.timer = nil
    for index = #Native.fades, 1, -1 do
        if Native.fades[index] == fade then
            table.remove(Native.fades, index)
        end
    end
end

function Native.cancelFade(gameObject)
    local id = gameObject:GetInstanceID()
    for index = #Native.fades, 1, -1 do
        local fade = Native.fades[index]
        if fade.id == id then
            Native.removeFade(fade)
        end
    end
end

-- 粒子飞完或超时就隐藏模板；返回这条收尾是否已了结。
function Native.settleFade(fade, now)
    if Native.isDestroyed(fade.go) then
        return true
    end
    local age = now - fade.startTime
    if age < Native.FadeGraceSeconds or (age < Native.FadeTimeoutSeconds and Native.isAlive(fade.info)) then
        return false
    end
    pcall(function()
        fade.go:SetActive(false)
    end)
    return true
end

-- 已被重播或立即停止取消的收尾不在表里，迟到的回调据此放弃，不会隐藏重新播放的模板。
function Native.watchFade(fade)
    local function tick()
        fade.timer = nil
        local pending = false
        for _, entry in ipairs(Native.fades) do
            pending = pending or entry == fade
        end
        if not pending then
            return
        end
        local ok, settled = pcall(Native.settleFade, fade, CS.UnityEngine.Time.time)
        if not ok or settled then
            Native.removeFade(fade)
            return
        end
        fade.timer = Native.schedule(tick, Native.FadePollSeconds)
    end
    fade.timer = Native.schedule(tick, Native.FadeGraceSeconds)
end

-- 与 C# PlayTemplate 一致：资源未就绪时不激活、不播放，避免露出尚未还原参数的粒子。
function Native.play(template)
    if not Native.isReady(template) then
        return false
    end
    Native.cancelFade(template)
    if not template.activeSelf then
        template:SetActive(true)
    end
    Native.restart(template, Native.owned(template))
    return true
end

-- 与 C# StopTemplate 一致：自然收尾先停发射，粒子飞完后隐藏，否则附属节点常显、祖先重新激活时还会重播。
function Native.stop(template, immediate)
    Native.cancelFade(template)
    local info = Native.collect(template)
    local behavior = CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystemStopBehavior
    if immediate then
        for _, system in ipairs(info.all) do
            system:Stop(false, behavior.StopEmittingAndClear)
        end
        template:SetActive(false)
        return
    end
    if not template.activeSelf then
        return
    end
    for _, system in ipairs(info.all) do
        system:Stop(false, behavior.StopEmitting)
    end
    local fade = { go = template, id = template:GetInstanceID(), info = info, startTime = CS.UnityEngine.Time.time }
    Native.fades[#Native.fades + 1] = fade
    Native.watchFade(fade)
end

function Native.isAlive(info)
    for _, system in ipairs(info.all) do
        local ok, alive = pcall(function()
            return system:IsAlive(true)
        end)
        if ok and alive then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- 倍率不是曲线寿命的上界，副本必须等整棵子树的粒子结束；与 C# 非循环池一样保留 30 秒超时。
-- 引擎先登记销毁兜底，宿主没有定时器、收集失败或后续调度失败时也不会永久留下副本。
function Native.finishSpawn(copy)
    destroyObject(copy, Native.FadeTimeoutSeconds)
    local info = Native.collect(copy)
    local startTime = CS.UnityEngine.Time.time
    local function tick()
        if Native.isDestroyed(copy) then
            return
        end
        local ok, finished = pcall(function()
            return CS.UnityEngine.Time.time - startTime >= Native.FadeTimeoutSeconds or not Native.isAlive(info)
        end)
        if not ok then
            return
        end
        if finished then
            destroyObject(copy)
            return
        end
        Native.schedule(tick, Native.FadePollSeconds)
    end
    Native.schedule(tick, Native.FadeGraceSeconds)
end

-- 每次调用本模块时补做：宿主没有定时器时由这里收尾，并清掉已销毁副本的记录。
function Native.sweep()
    local now = CS.UnityEngine.Time.time
    for index = #Native.fades, 1, -1 do
        local fade = Native.fades[index]
        if fade ~= nil and Native.settleFade(fade, now) then
            Native.removeFade(fade)
        end
    end
    for id, live in pairs(Native.copies) do
        for index = #live, 1, -1 do
            if Native.isDestroyed(live[index]) then
                table.remove(live, index)
            end
        end
        if #live == 0 then
            Native.copies[id] = nil
        end
    end
end

-- 未指定 parent 的副本挂到调用方所在世界根下的池节点，随世界一起销毁，不留在场景根上跨会话存活。
function Native.copyParent(context)
    local transform = resolveTransform(context)
    if transform == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local root = transform.root
    if not root.gameObject.activeInHierarchy then
        return nil
    end
    local pool = root:Find(Native.PoolRootName)
    if pool == nil then
        pool = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject(Native.PoolRootName).transform
        pool:SetParent(root, false)
    end
    return pool
end

-- 每个模板最多保留 8 个在播副本，超出时销毁最早的，等效于 C# 池满后重启最早一个。
function Native.track(template, copy)
    local id = template:GetInstanceID()
    local live = Native.copies[id]
    if live == nil then
        live = {}
        Native.copies[id] = live
    end
    live[#live + 1] = copy
    while #live > Native.CopyCapacity do
        destroyObject(table.remove(live, 1))
    end
end

-- 加载时一次性选定后端；两者都没有时整个模块降级为空操作，绝不能让 require 或调用打断 chunk。
local backend = nil
do
    local ok, value = pcall(function()
        return CS.EffectSystem.Ins
    end)
    if ok and isRealCsValue(value) then
        Studio.system = value
        backend = Studio
    else
        local typeOk, particleSystem = pcall(function()
            return CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem
        end)
        if typeOk and isRealCsValue(particleSystem) then
            backend = Native
        end
    end
end

-- 收尾和副本记录的清理不能打断调用方，失败只留到下次再试。
local function sweep()
    if backend ~= nil and backend.sweep ~= nil then
        pcall(backend.sweep)
    end
end

local function resolveTemplate(context, key)
    if backend == nil then
        logger:warnOnce(Effect.Reason.Unavailable, "effect playback disabled: host has no EffectSystem")
        return nil, Effect.Reason.Unavailable
    end
    sweep()

    local gameObject = resolveGameObject(context)
    if gameObject == nil then
        return nil, Effect.Reason.InvalidContext
    end
    if type(key) ~= "string" then
        local valid, isGameObject = pcall(function()
            return typeof(CS.UnityEngine.GameObject):IsInstanceOfType(key)
        end)
        if not valid or not isGameObject then
            return nil, Effect.Reason.InvalidKey
        end
        local ok, template, reason = pcall(backend.resolveReferenced, key)
        if not ok then
            return nil, Effect.Reason.NotFound
        end
        return template, reason
    end
    if key == "" then
        return nil, Effect.Reason.InvalidKey
    end

    local ok, template = pcall(backend.resolve, gameObject, key)
    if not ok or template == nil then
        logger:warnOnce("not-found:" .. key, "effect not found in this resource:", key)
        return nil, Effect.Reason.NotFound
    end
    return template
end

local function isReady(template)
    local ok, ready = pcall(backend.isReady, template)
    return ok and ready == true
end

local function isLooping(template)
    local ok, looping = pcall(backend.isLooping, template)
    return ok and looping == true
end

local function isActiveInHierarchy(gameObject)
    local ok, active = pcall(function()
        return gameObject.activeInHierarchy
    end)
    return ok and active == true
end

-- 与生成侧「发射时长 ≤30 秒」预算及宿主池的超时回收一致。
local PLAYBACK_LIMIT_SECONDS = 30
local PLAYBACK_MARGIN_SECONDS = 1

--- 复制模板并摆好后播放；失败时销毁副本并返回原因。
local function playCopy(context, template, key, position, options)
    local copy = nil
    local ok, failure = pcall(function()
        local source = template.transform
        local rotation = options ~= nil and options.rotation or source.rotation
        local scale = options ~= nil and options.scale or 1
        local parent = options ~= nil and resolveTransform(options.parent) or nil
        if parent == nil and backend.copyParent ~= nil then
            -- 取不到池节点时退回场景根，不让收纳失败挡住播放。
            local found, pool = pcall(backend.copyParent, context)
            parent = found and pool or nil
        end
        copy = CS.UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(template, position or source.position, rotation)
        backend.adopt(template, copy)
        local transform = copy.transform
        if parent ~= nil then
            transform:SetParent(parent, true)
        end
        local baseScale = source.localScale
        transform.localScale = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(baseScale.x * scale, baseScale.y * scale, baseScale.z * scale)
        -- 副本沿用模板的激活状态；studio 激活时由 MonoChain.Awake 按复制来源接管特效资源。
        copy:SetActive(true)
    end)
    if ok and copy ~= nil then
        local played, result = pcall(backend.play, copy)
        if played and result == true and isActiveInHierarchy(copy) then
            return copy
        end
        failure = "instance did not play"
    end
    local inactive = ok and copy ~= nil and not isActiveInHierarchy(copy)
    destroyObject(copy)
    if inactive then
        return nil, Effect.Reason.Inactive
    end
    logger:warnOnce("copy-failed:" .. tostring(key), "effect copy failed:", key, failure)
    return nil, Effect.Reason.SpawnFailed
end

--- 循环特效没有结束信号：关闭副本自身粒子的循环，完整发射一个周期后停止、自然消散。
--- 只改副本，共享模板仍是循环特效。
local function stopLoopingAfterOneCycle(copy)
    pcall(function()
        local systems = copy:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem), true)
        for index = 0, systems.Length - 1 do
            local system = systems[index]
            system.main.loop = false
            -- 预热把开播时刻推到周期末尾，关闭循环后会立即停发；拨回起点以保留预热外观并完整发射一个周期。
            if system.isPlaying then
                system.time = 0
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- Studio 循环副本的延时销毁估算：延迟 + 发射时长 + 寿命倍率，按 simulationSpeed 换算并累加子发射器。
local function playbackSeconds(copy)
    local ok, seconds = pcall(function()
        local array = copy:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem), true)
        local systems, spans, parents = {}, {}, {}
        for index = 0, array.Length - 1 do
            local system = array[index]
            local main = system.main
            local simulated = main.startDelayMultiplier + main.duration + main.startLifetimeMultiplier
            -- 下限与特效预览采样一致。
            spans[system] = simulated / math.max(0.01, main.simulationSpeed)
            systems[#systems + 1] = system
        end
        for _, system in ipairs(systems) do
            pcall(function()
                local module = system.subEmitters
                if not module.enabled then
                    return
                end
                for subIndex = 0, module.subEmittersCount - 1 do
                    local target = module:GetSubEmitterSystem(subIndex)
                    if target ~= nil and spans[target] ~= nil then
                        parents[target] = parents[target] or {}
                        table.insert(parents[target], system)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        local finish = {}
        local function finishOf(system, depth)
            if finish[system] == nil then
                local start = 0
                -- 深度上限挡住异常数据里的子发射器环。
                if depth < #systems then
                    for _, parent in ipairs(parents[system] or {}) do
                        start = math.max(start, finishOf(parent, depth + 1))
                    end
                end
                finish[system] = start + spans[system]
            end
            return finish[system]
        end
        local longest = 0
        for _, system in ipairs(systems) do
            longest = math.max(longest, finishOf(system, 0))
        end
        return longest + PLAYBACK_MARGIN_SECONDS
    end)
    if not ok or type(seconds) ~= "number" then
        return PLAYBACK_LIMIT_SECONDS
    end
    return math.min(seconds, PLAYBACK_LIMIT_SECONDS)
end

--- 播放一次，结束后自动回收，调用方不销毁返回的副本。
--- studio 非循环特效从宿主池取副本；Native 副本按粒子实际结束销毁，Studio 循环副本沿用延时销毁。
--- key 支持效果根名称或 GameObject 引用；position 省略时使用模板位置，此时忽略 options。
--- options 支持 rotation / scale / parent。
function Effect.spawn(context, key, position, options)
    local template, reason = resolveTemplate(context, key)
    if template == nil then
        return nil, reason
    end
    if not isReady(template) then
        logger:warnOnce("not-ready:" .. tostring(key), "effect is still loading:", key)
        return nil, Effect.Reason.NotReady
    end
    local looping = isLooping(template)
    if looping or backend.spawn == nil then
        local copy, failure = playCopy(context, template, key, position, position ~= nil and options or nil)
        if copy == nil then
            return nil, failure
        end
        if looping then
            stopLoopingAfterOneCycle(copy)
        end
        if backend.finishSpawn ~= nil then
            pcall(backend.finishSpawn, copy)
        else
            destroyObject(copy, playbackSeconds(copy))
        end
        if backend.track ~= nil then
            pcall(backend.track, template, copy)
        end
        return copy
    end

    local gameObject = resolveGameObject(context)
    local ok, instance, failure = pcall(backend.spawn, gameObject, template, key, position, options)
    if ok and instance == nil and failure ~= nil then
        return nil, failure
    end
    if not ok or instance == nil then
        logger:warnOnce("spawn-failed:" .. tostring(key), "effect spawn failed:", key, ok and "pool exhausted" or instance)
        return nil, Effect.Reason.SpawnFailed
    end
    return instance
end

local Handle = {}
Handle.__index = Handle

--- 播放句柄控制的那一个对象；重复调用会打断上一次。返回是否实际在播放。
--- 宿主只激活对象自身：祖先未激活时返回 false，祖先激活后对象按 OnEnable 自行播放。
--- 资产引用模板挂在关闭的缓存层级下，因此 find 句柄对它始终返回 false。
function Handle:Play()
    local target = self.target
    if target == nil then
        return false
    end
    sweep()
    local ok, played = pcall(backend.play, target)
    return ok and played == true and isActiveInHierarchy(target)
end

--- 默认停止发射，粒子消散后隐藏；immediate=true 立即清空粒子并隐藏。
function Handle:Stop(immediate)
    local target = self.target
    if target == nil then
        return false
    end
    sweep()
    return pcall(backend.stop, target, immediate == true)
end

--- 销毁 Effect.create 创建的实例，残留粒子一并清除。find 句柄不拥有模板，调用无效果并返回 false。
function Handle:Release()
    local target = self.target
    if not self.owned or target == nil then
        return false
    end
    self.target = nil
    destroyObject(target)
    return true
end

function Handle:IsReady()
    return self.target ~= nil and isReady(self.target)
end

function Handle:IsLooping()
    return self.target ~= nil and isLooping(self.target)
end

function Handle:GetGameObject()
    return self.target
end

--- 按名称或 GameObject 引用取模板自身的句柄，用于控制场景中已有的效果根。
--- 资产引用模板位于关闭的缓存层级，Play 返回 false；需要播放时用 Effect.create。
function Effect.find(context, key)
    local template, reason = resolveTemplate(context, key)
    if template == nil then
        return nil, reason
    end
    return setmetatable({ key = key, target = template }, Handle)
end

--- 复制模板得到调用方独占的实例，摆好后立即播放；循环与一次性特效都可用。
--- 实例不进池，不再需要时调用 handle:Release()；跟随的 parent 被销毁时实例随之销毁。
--- position 省略时使用模板位置；options 支持 rotation / scale / parent，parent 须处于激活层级。
function Effect.create(context, key, position, options)
    local template, reason = resolveTemplate(context, key)
    if template == nil then
        return nil, reason
    end
    if not isReady(template) then
        logger:warnOnce("not-ready:" .. tostring(key), "effect is still loading:", key)
        return nil, Effect.Reason.NotReady
    end
    local copy, failure = playCopy(context, template, key, position, options)
    if copy == nil then
        return nil, failure
    end
    return setmetatable({ key = key, target = copy, owned = true }, Handle)
end

--- 宿主是否提供特效播放能力（编辑器 EffectSystem，或预览端、发布态的原生 ParticleSystem）。
function Effect.isAvailable()
    return backend ~= nil
end

return Effect

local Collider = CS.UnityEngine.Collider
local Vector3 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3

local Containment = {}

Containment.Reason = {
    InvalidOptions = "containment-invalid-options",
    InvalidSubject = "containment-invalid-subject",
    InvalidContainer = "containment-invalid-container",
    InvalidInset = "containment-invalid-inset",
    InvalidEpsilon = "containment-invalid-epsilon",
    QueryFailed = "containment-query-failed",
    NoSubjectCollider = "containment-no-subject-collider",
    NoContainerCollider = "containment-no-container-collider",
    CollapsedContainer = "containment-collapsed-container",
    EvaluationFailed = "containment-evaluation-failed",
}

local function isFiniteNumber(value)
    return type(value) == "number"
        and value == value
        and value ~= math.huge
        and value ~= -math.huge
end

local function resolveTransform(value)
    if value == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return value.transform
    end)
    if ok and transform ~= nil then
        return transform
    end

    ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return value.gameObject.transform
    end)
    if ok and transform ~= nil then
        return transform
    end

    ok, transform = pcall(function()
        local _ = value.childCount
        return value
    end)
    if ok then
        return transform
    end
    return nil
end

local function readInset(value)
    if value == nil then
        return { x = 0, y = 0, z = 0 }
    end
    if isFiniteNumber(value) and value >= 0 then
        return { x = value, y = value, z = value }
    end

    local ok, x, y, z = pcall(function()
        return value.x, value.y, value.z
    end)
    if not ok
        or not isFiniteNumber(x) or x < 0
        or not isFiniteNumber(y) or y < 0
        or not isFiniteNumber(z) or z < 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return { x = x, y = y, z = z }
end

local function queryColliders(rootTransform, includeInactive)
    local gameObject = rootTransform.gameObject
    local colliders = gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(Collider), includeInactive)
    local result = {}
    if colliders ~= nil then
        for index = 0, colliders.Length - 1 do
            local collider = colliders[index]
            if collider ~= nil then
                result[#result + 1] = collider
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end

local function includeCollider(collider, excluded)
    return (excluded == nil or excluded[collider] ~= true)
        and collider.enabled == true
        and collider.isTrigger ~= true
end

local function appendPoint(bounds, point)
    if not isFiniteNumber(point.x)
        or not isFiniteNumber(point.y)
        or not isFiniteNumber(point.z) then
        error("containment point is not finite")
    end

    if bounds.empty then
        bounds.minX, bounds.maxX = point.x, point.x
        bounds.minY, bounds.maxY = point.y, point.y
        bounds.minZ, bounds.maxZ = point.z, point.z
        bounds.empty = false
        return
    end

    bounds.minX = math.min(bounds.minX, point.x)
    bounds.maxX = math.max(bounds.maxX, point.x)
    bounds.minY = math.min(bounds.minY, point.y)
    bounds.maxY = math.max(bounds.maxY, point.y)
    bounds.minZ = math.min(bounds.minZ, point.z)
    bounds.maxZ = math.max(bounds.maxZ, point.z)
end

local function appendLocalBoundsCorners(bounds, center, size, sourceTransform, referenceTransform)
    local halfX = size.x * 0.5
    local halfY = size.y * 0.5
    local halfZ = size.z * 0.5

    for xSign = -1, 1, 2 do
        for ySign = -1, 1, 2 do
            for zSign = -1, 1, 2 do
                local sourcePoint = Vector3(
                    center.x + halfX * xSign,
                    center.y + halfY * ySign,
                    center.z + halfZ * zSign
                )
                local worldPoint = sourceTransform:TransformPoint(sourcePoint)
                appendPoint(bounds, referenceTransform:InverseTransformPoint(worldPoint))
            end
        end
    end
end

local function appendWorldBoundsCorners(bounds, worldBounds, referenceTransform)
    local min = worldBounds.min
    local max = worldBounds.max
    for xIndex = 0, 1 do
        for yIndex = 0, 1 do
            for zIndex = 0, 1 do
                local worldPoint = Vector3(
                    xIndex == 0 and min.x or max.x,
                    yIndex == 0 and min.y or max.y,
                    zIndex == 0 and min.z or max.z
                )
                appendPoint(bounds, referenceTransform:InverseTransformPoint(worldPoint))
            end
        end
    end
end

local function appendColliderCorners(bounds, collider, referenceTransform)
    local localBoundsOk, center, size = pcall(function()
        return collider.center, collider.size
    end)
    if localBoundsOk and center ~= nil and size ~= nil then
        appendLocalBoundsCorners(bounds, center, size, collider.transform, referenceTransform)
        return
    end

    local meshBoundsOk, meshCenter, meshSize = pcall(function()
        local mesh = collider.sharedMesh
        if mesh == nil then return nil, nil end
        return mesh.bounds.center, mesh.bounds.size
    end)
    if meshBoundsOk and meshCenter ~= nil and meshSize ~= nil then
        appendLocalBoundsCorners(bounds, meshCenter, meshSize, collider.transform, referenceTransform)
        return
    end

    appendWorldBoundsCorners(bounds, collider.bounds, referenceTransform)
end

local function collectBounds(colliders, excluded, referenceTransform, missingReason)
    local bounds = { empty = true }
    local colliderCount = 0
    for _, collider in ipairs(colliders) do
        if includeCollider(collider, excluded) then
            appendColliderCorners(bounds, collider, referenceTransform)
            colliderCount = colliderCount + 1
        end
    end
    if colliderCount == 0 then
        return nil, missingReason
    end
    return bounds
end

local function toPublicBounds(bounds)
    return {
        min = Vector3(bounds.minX, bounds.minY, bounds.minZ),
        max = Vector3(bounds.maxX, bounds.maxY, bounds.maxZ),
    }
end

local function findOutside(subject, container)
    if subject.minX < container.minX then
        return "x", "min", container.minX - subject.minX
    end
    if subject.maxX > container.maxX then
        return "x", "max", subject.maxX - container.maxX
    end
    if subject.minY < container.minY then
        return "y", "min", container.minY - subject.minY
    end
    if subject.maxY > container.maxY then
        return "y", "max", subject.maxY - container.maxY
    end
    if subject.minZ < container.minZ then
        return "z", "min", container.minZ - subject.minZ
    end
    if subject.maxZ > container.maxZ then
        return "z", "max", subject.maxZ - container.maxZ
    end
    return nil
end

local function evaluate(checker)
    local subjectBounds, subjectReason = collectBounds(
        checker.subjectColliders,
        nil,
        checker.containerTransform,
        Containment.Reason.NoSubjectCollider
    )
    if subjectBounds == nil then
        return nil, subjectReason
    end

    local containerBounds, containerReason = collectBounds(
        checker.containerColliders,
        checker.subjectColliderSet,
        checker.containerTransform,
        Containment.Reason.NoContainerCollider
    )
    if containerBounds == nil then
        return nil, containerReason
    end

    local minInset = checker.containerMinInset
    local maxInset = checker.containerMaxInset
    local epsilon = checker.epsilon
    local effectiveContainer = {
        minX = containerBounds.minX + minInset.x - epsilon,
        maxX = containerBounds.maxX - maxInset.x + epsilon,
        minY = containerBounds.minY + minInset.y - epsilon,
        maxY = containerBounds.maxY - maxInset.y + epsilon,
        minZ = containerBounds.minZ + minInset.z - epsilon,
        maxZ = containerBounds.maxZ - maxInset.z + epsilon,
    }
    if effectiveContainer.minX >= effectiveContainer.maxX
        or effectiveContainer.minY >= effectiveContainer.maxY
        or effectiveContainer.minZ >= effectiveContainer.maxZ then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.CollapsedContainer
    end

    local outsideAxis, outsideSide, outsideDistance = findOutside(subjectBounds, effectiveContainer)
    local details = {
        subjectBounds = toPublicBounds(subjectBounds),
        containerBounds = toPublicBounds(containerBounds),
        effectiveContainerBounds = toPublicBounds(effectiveContainer),
        outsideAxis = outsideAxis,
        outsideSide = outsideSide,
        outsideDistance = outsideDistance,
    }
    return outsideAxis == nil, details
end

local Checker = {}
Checker.__index = Checker

function Checker:check()
    local ok, contained, details = pcall(evaluate, self)
    if not ok then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.EvaluationFailed
    end
    return contained, details
end

function Containment.create(options)
    if type(options) ~= "table" then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.InvalidOptions
    end
    if options.includeInactive ~= nil and type(options.includeInactive) ~= "boolean" then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.InvalidOptions
    end

    local subjectTransform = resolveTransform(options.subjectRoot)
    if subjectTransform == nil then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.InvalidSubject
    end
    local containerTransform = resolveTransform(options.containerRoot)
    if containerTransform == nil then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.InvalidContainer
    end

    local containerInset = readInset(options.containerInset)
    if containerInset == nil then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.InvalidInset
    end
    local containerMinInset = options.containerMinInset == nil
        and containerInset
        or readInset(options.containerMinInset)
    local containerMaxInset = options.containerMaxInset == nil
        and containerInset
        or readInset(options.containerMaxInset)
    if containerMinInset == nil or containerMaxInset == nil then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.InvalidInset
    end
    local epsilon = options.epsilon
    if epsilon == nil then
        epsilon = 0.001
    end
    if not isFiniteNumber(epsilon) or epsilon < 0 then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.InvalidEpsilon
    end

    local ok, subjectColliders, containerColliders = pcall(function()
        return queryColliders(subjectTransform, options.includeInactive == true),
            queryColliders(containerTransform, options.includeInactive == true)
    end)
    if not ok then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.QueryFailed
    end

    local subjectColliderSet = {}
    for _, collider in ipairs(subjectColliders) do
        subjectColliderSet[collider] = true
    end

    return setmetatable({
        containerTransform = containerTransform,
        subjectColliders = subjectColliders,
        subjectColliderSet = subjectColliderSet,
        containerColliders = containerColliders,
        containerMinInset = containerMinInset,
        containerMaxInset = containerMaxInset,
        epsilon = epsilon,
    }, Checker)
end

return Containment

local BoxCollider = CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider
local Vector3 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3

local Trigger = {}

Trigger.Reason = {
    InvalidTarget = "trigger-invalid-target",
    QueryFailed = "trigger-query-failed",
    NotFound = "trigger-not-found",
    Ambiguous = "trigger-ambiguous",
    InvalidScale = "trigger-invalid-scale",
    ScaleFailed = "trigger-scale-failed",
}

local function resolveGameObject(value)
    if value == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, gameObject = pcall(function()
        return value.gameObject
    end)
    if ok and gameObject ~= nil then
        return gameObject
    end

    local transform
    ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return value.transform
    end)
    if ok and transform ~= nil then
        return value
    end
    return nil
end

function Trigger.findBoxCollider(value)
    local gameObject = resolveGameObject(value)
    if gameObject == nil then
        return nil, Trigger.Reason.InvalidTarget
    end

    local ok, collider, reason = pcall(function()
        local colliders = gameObject:GetComponents(typeof(BoxCollider))
        local found = nil
        if colliders ~= nil then
            for index = 0, colliders.Length - 1 do
                local candidate = colliders[index]
                if candidate ~= nil and candidate.isTrigger == true then
                    if found ~= nil then
                        return nil, Trigger.Reason.Ambiguous
                    end
                    found = candidate
                end
            end
        end

        if found == nil then
            return nil, Trigger.Reason.NotFound
        end
        return found
    end)
    if not ok then
        return nil, Trigger.Reason.QueryFailed
    end
    return collider, reason
end

function Trigger.applyRangeScale(value, scale)
    if type(scale) ~= "number" or scale ~= scale or scale == math.huge or scale == -math.huge then
        return nil, Trigger.Reason.InvalidScale
    end

    local collider, reason = Trigger.findBoxCollider(value)
    if collider == nil then
        return nil, reason
    end

    local ok = pcall(function()
        local size = collider.size
        collider.size = Vector3(
            size.x * scale,
            size.y * scale,
            size.z * scale
        )
    end)
    if not ok then
        return nil, Trigger.Reason.ScaleFailed
    end
    return collider
end

return Trigger
